senses.gloss: m. pl. (פְּהֵי) wandering about, idleness; בשיהי פ׳ in standing still and sauntering about, in idleness. Targ. II Esth. III, 8; Meg. 13ᵇ Ms. M. (ed. בשה״י פה״י, expl. in Rashi as an acrostic abbreviation: ש̇בת ה̇י̇ום, פ̇סח ה̇יו̇ם to-day is Sabbath, to-day is Passover); Yalk. Esth. 1054 בשהי פהי.
